performance_issues.impact: With default page size 30: up to 60 extra queries (30 user + 30 attachment queries). With max 50: up to 100 extra queries.

performance_issues.recommendation: Batch load publishers and use GetReleaseAttachments with all releases at once (the function already supports batch)

optimization_recommendations.description: Use batch GetReleaseAttachments for all releases at once instead of per-release LoadAttributes
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce N attachment queries to 1 batch query
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Call GetReleaseAttachments(ctx, releases...) once after the Find, then batch-load publishers

performance_issues.description: Attachment file deletion from storage happens synchronously in the request path
performance_issues.impact: If many attachments exist, storage deletion could slow the response
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider async deletion of attachment files via a background queue

optimization_recommendations.description: Move attachment file deletion to a background job
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Faster DELETE response when releases have many attachments
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Queue attachment UUIDs for async deletion after DB records are removed
